hero_title: Grant-ready GIS for Tennessee and Southern Kentucky
hero_content:
APSU GIS Center helps public agencies and regional partners move from fragmented data to actionable plans.

Our team delivers decision-ready maps, dashboards, and analytics that support public safety, infrastructure resilience, and economic development outcomes.
quote_content: APSU GIS Center combines local context, technical rigor, and public-sector collaboration to deliver outcomes that leaders can act on. The result is not just mapping output—it is decision support that improves readiness, strengthens proposals, and accelerates implementation.
